patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff itself does not apply cleanly to the ARVO workspace checkout, so fixed-side validation used the authoritative n132/arvo:66510-fix image. That fixed image reaches the same root site with the original PoC but emits only the guarded lookahead boundary event (no protected sink), and on the closest successful perturbation case payload_prefix_plus_1 it executes the protected lookahead with lookahead_ptr < block_end and a fully initialized literal byte. This matches the source-level fix in patch.diff, which adds the missing && LIKELY(ip + cur < iend) guard at the traced root-cause branch.

nodes.description: At the selected lookahead sink, ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost reads one byte from literals[0]. In the vulnerable crash case that byte is still uninitialized workspace state: the selected sink event shows literal_initialized_prefix_len=0 while read_len=1.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable original trace records literal_read_sink.literal_initialized_prefix_len=0 and literal_read_sink.read_len=1 at the crashing ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost call.

edges.description: The same lookahead pointer computed as ip + cur in ZSTD_compressBlock_opt_generic is passed unchanged as literals into ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost for the one-byte LIT_PRICE lookup.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable original trace records lookahead_guard.lookahead_ptr == literal_read_sink.literals_ptr for the selected crash-path event pair.

root_cause_criterion.description: Before the extra one-literal pricing branch executes its LIT_PRICE(ip+cur) lookahead, the computed source expression ip + cur must be strictly less than iend. The vulnerable code omits this root bound check, so the exact end-of-block boundary remains eligible for a nonexistent next literal.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original trace violates the required predicate with lookahead_ptr == block_end while the protected sink executes. The fixed original trace is guarded at that same boundary (lookahead_guard fires, literal_read_sink is absent). On the closest source-grounded perturbation payload_prefix_plus_1, the authoritative fixed image provides a genuine witness with lookahead_ptr < block_end and the protected sink executing on an initialized byte.
